store.reinit.title: Reinitialize a missing store
store.reinit.summary: Create a new empty project store and identity, replacing its old device registration. Refuse if a store is present.

catalog.describe.title: Describe a command
catalog.describe.summary: Show the full declaration and schemas for a command.

catalog.call.title: Call a command
catalog.call.summary: Invoke a command by its operation name.

block.add.title: Capture a block
block.add.summary: Register a block and report its digest; pending human admission returns the next command.

block.check.title: Check a block
block.check.summary: Validate a block and report its digest.

block.admit.title: Admit a block
block.admit.summary: Admit captured block bytes for this device.

examples.command: POSIX: forge block admit "$(forge block check ./example-block | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).result.digest')"
PowerShell 5.1: forge block admit ((forge block check ./example-block | ConvertFrom-Json).result.digest)

skills.sync.title: Sync skills
skills.sync.summary: Sync skills and companions into each enabled adapter's skills directory. --check writes nothing and exits 1 only for files sync would write or delete. User entries are skipped with a warning. To repair generated-file drift, run forge skills sync; it overwrites edits to generated files.

config.show.title: Show configuration
config.show.summary: Read the effective configuration and its current revision.

config.explain.title: Explain a value
config.explain.summary: Show where a configuration value came from.

config.detect.title: Detect project settings
config.detect.summary: Detect project settings without saving them.

config.set.title: Set a value
config.set.summary: Set one value at the revision read from config show.

examples.command: POSIX: forge config set memory.levels.human nearest --expect-revision "$(forge config show | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).result.revision')"
PowerShell 5.1: forge config set memory.levels.human nearest --expect-revision ((forge config show | ConvertFrom-Json).result.revision)

config.preview.title: Preview edits
config.preview.summary: Preview configuration edits without saving them.

config.apply.title: Apply edits
config.apply.summary: Apply edits at the revision read from config show.

examples.command: POSIX: forge config apply --patch '[{"op":"set","path":"/values/example","value":true}]' --expect-revision "$(forge config show | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).result.revision')"
PowerShell 5.1: forge config apply --patch '[{\"op\":\"set\",\"path\":\"/values/example\",\"value\":true}]' --expect-revision ((forge config show | ConvertFrom-Json).result.revision)

config.save.title: Save detected settings
config.save.summary: Save detected settings at the revision read from config show.

examples.command: POSIX: forge config save --expect-revision "$(forge config show | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).result.revision')"
PowerShell 5.1: forge config save --expect-revision ((forge config show | ConvertFrom-Json).result.revision)

config.grant.title: Grant effects
config.grant.summary: Allow named effects for human-admitted bytes.

examples.command: POSIX: forge config grant --effects '[]' --digest "$(forge block check ./example-block | node -pe 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8")).result.digest')"
PowerShell 5.1: forge config grant --effects '[]' --digest ((forge block check ./example-block | ConvertFrom-Json).result.digest)
